activity_summary: Before any news from the river, Edith asked for a cloak and two sleeves for the autumn. Her terms were payment on delivery, and no more accounts. You began to describe the uncertainty of the season. Kemp said that uncertainty was her point. John accepted the terms and cut the order to the sleeves and not the cloak, at six shillings. Edith told him to pay her in coin and the weather in promises. The work is not delivered, and it is not paid.
